features: All in One Box & Assembly Required: The package dimension of our queen bed frame is 63.98”L *22.64”W *7.28”H. All the parts and tools are in the box.

4 Storage Drawers: This queen bed frame is equipped with 4 large storage drawers, which can provide extra storage space for you. With a consistent style, 4 built-in sliding drawers can make your bedroom look tidy and neat. Its lockable design allows you to securely lock the drawers without slipping out when not in use.

All-Metal Support: The support system of the bed frame consist of strong metal, which is sturdy and durable. The structure design can easily support up to 800lbs. Mattress can be put on the queen bed frame directly, so it not only gives you a great sense of security, but also lets you simplify your bed preparation.

Faux Leather: The appearance of this bed frame is designed to be fashion and modern, which satisfies the matching of space. Headboard and footboard are wrapped in breathable faux leather, with a built-in high resilience memory sponge. And the button tufted design and rivet embellishments on them are full of the flavor of fashion.

Adjustable Headboard: The height adjustable headboard is designed to expand your selection space of mattresses. It can be adjusted from 40 to 42 inches in height, allows you to use an 8-12 inch mattress. You can choose the right mattress according to your certain needs and preferences.
